description: This Dart file defines a StatelessWidget for the 'Order History' screen in a Flutter application. It displays a list of past orders, allows tapping on an order to potentially reorder the first item, and integrates localization and provider state management.

classes.name: OrderHistoryScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget representing the order history page, displaying past orders in a list with options to reorder.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the order history screen, including app bar, list of orders, and handling tap events.
